label: Pool care
lede: Weekly cleaning, water chemistry and repairs for pools and spas. Tell us about your pool and we'll send you a price.

services.Weekly pool service: Skim, brush, vacuum, empty the baskets and balance the water on a set day each week.
services.Green pool cleanup: Algae cleared and the water brought back to blue.
services.Chemical balancing: Chlorine, pH, alkalinity and stabilizer tested and adjusted.
services.Filter cleaning: Cartridge and DE filters taken apart, cleaned and put back.
services.Equipment repair: Pumps, heaters, salt cells and timers diagnosed and fixed.
services.Tile & waterline cleaning: Calcium scale and the scum line scrubbed off the tile.
services.Spa service: Spas and hot tubs cleaned and balanced along with the pool.
services.Seasonal care: Regular checks on your pool while you're up north.
